title: NSubstitute
description: A friendly mocking library with a simple, natural syntax for .NET.

data.text: `NSubstitute` is a mocking library designed for readability. It avoids complex configuration and instead uses a straightforward syntax where calling a method on a substitute automatically creates the return value.
Use `Substitute.For<T>()` to create a substitute. Configure returns with `.Returns()` and received calls with `.Received()`.

data.content: Create and configure a substitute with NSubstitute.

data.text: NSubstitute can also raise events or throw exceptions to test event handlers and error handling.

data.title: Tip
data.text: NSubstitute does not require explicit Setup calls. If you call a method on a substitute without configuring it, it returns a default value automatically.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: NSubstitute uses Substitute.For<T>() to create mocks
No explicit Setup required for simple cases
data.takeaway: NSubstitute prioritizes readability with minimal ceremony for test setup.
